queue.order: UTC arrival time, then stable wafer ID

baseline_A: RF77 calibrated P(any defect), descending, fill budget
challenger_B: 0.9 * sum_c P(c)*L(c) - 0.1; descending, strictly positive, up to budget

primary.units: hypothetical relative loss units per 1000 eligible arrivals

sensitivity: Reprice the same two locked lists with Scratch loss 1. No re-ranking.

sampling.draw: within stratum simple random sample without replacement; ceil(rate*N), minimum 2 up to census

inference.cluster: connected groups of lots linked by identical maps
inference.decision: If the paired interval for B-A lies below zero, favor B; if above zero, favor A; otherwise inconclusive. One fixed stop, no interim model changes.

modeling_scope: Seed 123 and 2026 belong to retrospective sensitivity, not prospective model selection.
